title: Understanding Blockchain Curation Rewards
body: Blockchain networks like Steem reward content creators and curators through a unique economic model. Curation rewards play a vital role in maintaining content quality and encouraging meaningful engagement. On Steem, curators stake their tokens to vote on posts, and successful predictions about valuable content can earn them rewards. The daily curation activity across the network demonstrates how this mechanism functions in practice. Understanding how curation works helps both new and experienced users participate more effectively. When you curate content thoughtfully, you're not just supporting creators—you're also contributing to the platform's overall health. The curation reward system creates a symbiotic relationship between creators and curators, ensuring that quality content rises to the top. As you explore the platform, consider how your own curation choices impact the ecosystem and what makes content valuable to you.
